TaskDescription: Subjects focus attention on a single violet box flickering at different frequencies (6.66, 7.50, 8.57, 10.00, 12.00 Hz) presented sequentially. Each frequency is presented for 5 seconds (trial) followed by 5 seconds rest, repeated 3 times per frequency, with 30 seconds rest between different frequencies. Trial duration: 5.0s, stimulus frequencies: [6.66, 7.5, 8.57, 10.0, 12.0] Hz.
Instructions: Subjects were instructed to focus attention on the flickering box, limit movements, and avoid swallowing or blinking during visual stimulation
InstitutionName: Centre for Research and Technology Hellas (CERTH)
Description: Comparative evaluation of state-of-the-art algorithms for SSVEP-based BCIs
